headers: ADWOGI ME CATO WIL DUCU I MWAKA
rows: Adwogi cato wil ducu pe kato Ciling million apar (10).
Adwogi cato wil ducu kato ciling million apar (10) ento pe kato ciling million pyeradek (30).
0.4% (pacen) me wel cato wil weng/ducu pi mwaka acel ma okato iwi ciling million apar (10)
Adwogi cato wil weng/ducu kato ciling million pyeradek (30) ento pe kato ciling million pyerabic (50)
Ciling alib 80,000 med ki 0.5% (pacen) me wel cato wil ducu pi mwaka acel ma okato iwi ciling  million 30.
Adwogi cato wil weng/ducu kato ciling million pyerabic (50) ento pe kato ciling million pyeraboro (80)
Ciling 180,000 med ki 0.6% (pacen) me wel cato wil weng/ducu pi mwaka acel ma okato iwi ciling million 50 (Pyerabic).
Adwogi cato wil weng/ducu kato ciling million 80 ento pe kato ciling million 150.
Ciling 360,000 med ki 0.7% me wel cato wil ducu pi mwaka acel ma okato iwi ciling million 80.
